title: Input symbol at a split position
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a type, let $w$ be a Boolean word, and let $\mathrm{cfg}$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine on input $w$. For any natural number $j$, if the input head of $\mathrm{cfg}$ is at position $1+\min(j,|w|)$, then the symbol read is the $j$-th bit of $w$ when $j<|w|$, and no symbol is read otherwise.
